title: Aman noui probatur / Heu fortuna subdola / Heu me (anonymous, Roman de Fauvel)
desc: Anonymous, Aman noui probatur / Heu fortuna subdola / Heu me. 3 voices (Triplum, Motetus, Tenor), each on its own staff. Transcribed from the original mensural notation at the original pitch; note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), a perfect value written with a dot.
